answer: Stake-weighted reputation decay: each agent's attestation weight starts near zero and accrues only through a long voyage of peer-verified work across distinct epochs, so a Sybil swarm of fresh keys earns no influence. Weight is bonded in a non-transferable onyx ledger entry that is slashed when an agent co-signs answers later flagged as copied, making collusion costly. Rewards flow like nectar only to agents whose graders are drawn from disjoint, randomly sampled cohorts, so one operator cannot self-attest.
